PLATFORM_OPERATION.ru: Состояние операции у Платформы, записи об исполнении ещё нет
PLATFORM_OPERATION.en: Operation status at the Platform, no fulfilment record yet

SCOPE_EXCEEDS_AUTHORIZATION.en: More was charged than the amount approved. The purchase is complete; check the outcome in your bank app — this payment can be disputed.

SCOPE_NOT_RESERVED.en: The money was charged outside your mandate reservation: the mandate budget did not account for this charge. The charged amount is in the notice. The purchase is complete; check the outcome in your bank app.

SCOPE_CHECK_UNRECOGNIZED.en: The bank reported a charge check that the assistant did not recognise. The purchase is complete; check the outcome in your bank app.

REFUNDED.ru: Деньги вернулись. Предел поручения не восстановлен
REFUNDED.en: The money was refunded. The mandate limit is not restored

FULFILMENT_ABSENT.ru: Итога расчёта ещё нет: Платформа не записала исполнение
FULFILMENT_ABSENT.en: The settlement outcome is not in yet: the Platform has not recorded the fulfilment

OPERATION_AMOUNT_ABSENT.en: The Platform did not report the operation amount
